verses.text: After these things, Jesus go di other side of di Sea of Galilee, wey dem dey call Sea of Tiberias too.
Big crowd follow am, because dem see im signs wey e do on di sick people.
Jesus go up di mountain, and e sit there with im disciples.
Now di Passover, di feast of di Jews, don near.
So Jesus lift up im eyes, see say big crowd dey come to am, talk to Philip say, “Wia we go buy bread, make these people chop?”
E talk this to test am, because e imself know wetin e go do.
Philip answer am, “Bread wey cost 200 denarii no go reach dem, even if each one of dem take small.”
One of im disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter brother, talk to am say,
“One boy dey here wey get five barley loaves and two fish, but wetin these ones be among so many?”
Jesus talk say, “Make di people sit down.” Now plenty grass dey for that place. So di men sit down, about 5,000.
Jesus take di loaves; and as e don thank God, e share dem give di disciples, and di disciples give di people wey sit down; na so too di fish, as much as dem want.
When dem don satisfy, e talk to im disciples say, “Gather di broken pieces wey remain, so that nothing go waste.”
So dem gather dem, fill 12 baskets with broken pieces from di five barley loaves, wey remain from di people wey chop.
So when di people see di sign wey Jesus do, dem talk say, “Na truly di prophet wey dey come enter di world.”
So Jesus know say dem dey about to come carry am by force make am king, e go back to di mountain by imself.
When evening reach, im disciples go down to di sea,
enter di boat, dey cross di sea go Capernaum. E don dark, and Jesus never come to dem.
Strong wind dey blow, di sea dey rough.
So when dem don row about 25 or 30 stadia, dem see Jesus dey waka on di sea, and dey near di boat; and dem fear.
But e talk to dem say, “Na me. No fear.”
So dem gree to receive am enter di boat. At once di boat reach di land wia dem dey go.
Di next day, di crowd wey stand for di other side of di sea see say no other boat dey there, except one, and say Jesus no enter di boat with im disciples, but say im disciples don go alone.
But boats from Tiberias come near di place wia dem chop di bread after Lord don thank God.
So when di crowd see say Jesus no dey there, and im disciples no dey, dem enter di boats, come Capernaum, dey look for Jesus.
When dem find am for di other side of di sea, dem talk to am say, “Rabbi, when you come here?”
Jesus answer dem, “Na true I dey tell una, una dey look for me, no be because una see signs, but because una chop di loaves, and una satisfy.
No work for food wey dey perish, but for food wey dey remain to life wey no dey end, wey di Son of Man go give una. Because Papa God don put im seal on am.”
So dem talk to am say, “Wetin we must do, so that we go do di works of God?”
Jesus answer dem, “Na this be di work of God, say una believe di one wey e send.”
So dem talk to am say, “Den wetin sign you dey do, so that we go see and believe you? Wetin work you dey do?
Our papa dem chop di manna for di wilderness. As e dey write, ‘E give dem bread from heaven to chop.’”
So Jesus talk to dem say, “Na true I dey tell una, no be Moses give una di bread from heaven, but my Papa God dey give una di true bread from heaven.
Because di bread of God na di one wey dey come down from heaven, and dey give life to di world.”
So dem talk to am say, “Lord, always give us this bread.”
Jesus talk to dem say, “I be di bread of life. Di one wey come to me no go hungry, and di one wey believe me no go ever thirst.
But I tell una say una don see me, and yet una no believe.
All wey Papa God give me go come to me. Di one wey come to me, I no go throw out at all.
Because I don come down from heaven, no be to do my own will, but di will of di one wey send me.
Na this be di will of my Papa God wey send me, say of all wey e don give me I no go lose any, but I go raise am up for di last day.
Na this be di will of di one wey send me, say everybody wey see di Pikin, and believe am, go get life wey no dey end; and I go raise am up for di last day.”
So di Jews dey grumble about am, because e talk say, “I be di bread wey come down from heaven.”
Dem talk say, “No be this Jesus, Joseph son, wey we know im papa and mama? How e take dey talk say, ‘I don come down from heaven?’”
So Jesus answer dem, “No grumble among yourselves.
Nobody fit come to me unless Papa God wey send me draw am, and I go raise am up for di last day.
E dey write for di prophets, ‘God go teach dem all.’ So everybody wey hear from Papa God, and don learn, dey come to me.
No be say anybody don see Papa God, except di one wey come from God. Na im don see Papa God.
Na true I dey tell una, di one wey believe me get life wey no dey end.
I be di bread of life.
Una papa dem chop di manna for di wilderness, and dem die.
Na this be di bread wey dey come down from heaven, so that anybody go chop am and no die.
I be di living bread wey come down from heaven. If anybody chop this bread, e go live forever. Di bread wey I go give for di life of di world na my flesh.”
So di Jews dey argue with each other, dey talk say, “How this man go take give us im flesh to chop?”
So Jesus talk to dem say, “Na true I dey tell una, unless una chop di flesh of di Son of Man and drink im blood, una no get life inside una.
Di one wey chop my flesh and drink my blood get life wey no dey end, and I go raise am up for di last day.
Because my flesh na real food, and my blood na real drink.
Di one wey chop my flesh and drink my blood dey live inside me, and I dey inside am.
As di living Papa God send me, and I dey live because of Papa God; so di one wey dey feed on me, e go live because of me too.
Na this be di bread wey come down from heaven—no be like our papa dem chop di manna, and dem die. Di one wey chop this bread go live forever.”
E talk these things for di synagogue, as e dey teach for Capernaum.
So plenty of im disciples, when dem hear this, talk say, “This word hard! Who fit listen to am?”
But Jesus know for imself say im disciples dey grumble about this, talk to dem say, “This one dey make una stumble?
Wetin if una go see di Son of Man dey go up to wia e dey before?
Na di spirit dey give life. Di flesh no profit anything. Di words wey I talk to una na spirit, and dem na life.
But some of una dey wey no believe.” Because Jesus know from di beginning who no believe, and who go betray am.
E talk say, “Na for this reason I talk to una say nobody fit come to me, unless my Papa God give am.”
From this, plenty of im disciples go back, and dem no waka with am again.
So Jesus talk to di 12, “Una no want go away too?”
Simon Peter answer am, “Lord, to who we go go? You get di words of life wey no dey end.
We don believe and know say you na di Christ, di Pikin of di living God.”
Jesus answer dem, “No be me choose una, di 12, and one of una na devil?”
E dey talk about Judas, Simon Iscariot son, because na im go betray am, as e be one of di 12.
After these things, Jesus dey waka for Galilee, because e no wan waka for Judea, because di Jews dey look for way to kill am.
Di Feast of Booths of di Jews don near.
So im brothers talk to am say, “Leave here, go Judea, so that your disciples go see di works wey you dey do too.
Because nobody dey do anything for secret, and at di same time dey want make people know am openly. If you dey do these things, show yourself to di world.”
Because even im brothers no believe am.
So Jesus talk to dem say, “My time never reach, but your time always ready.
Di world no fit hate una, but e hate me, because I dey testify about am say im works evil.
Una go up to di feast. I no go up to this feast yet, because my time never full.”
As e don talk these things to dem, e stay for Galilee.
But when im brothers don go up to di feast, den e go up too, no be openly, but like say na for secret.
So di Jews dey look for am for di feast, dey talk say, “Wia e dey?”
Plenty grumbling dey among di crowds about am. Some talk say, “E be good man.” Others talk say, “No be so, but e dey lead di crowd astray.”
Still, nobody talk about am openly because of fear of di Jews.
But when di feast don reach di middle, Jesus go up to di temple and teach.
So di Jews marvel, dey talk say, “How this man take know letters, as e never study?”
So Jesus answer dem, “My teaching no be mine, but na di one wey send me own.
If anybody want do im will, e go know about di teaching, whether e come from God, or na from myself I dey talk.
Di one wey dey talk from imself dey look for im own glory, but di one wey dey look for di glory of di one wey send am na true, and no unrighteousness dey inside am.
No be Moses give una di law, and yet none of una dey keep di law? Why una dey look for way to kill me?”
Di crowd answer, “Evil spirit dey inside you! Who dey look for way to kill you?”
Jesus answer dem, “I do one work, and una all marvel because of am.
Moses don give una circumcision, no be say e come from Moses, but from di papa dem, and for Sabbath una dey circumcise boy.
If boy receive circumcision for Sabbath, so that dem no go break di law of Moses, una vex with me, because I make man well completely for Sabbath?
No judge by appearance, but judge with righteous judgment.”
So some of di people of Jerusalem talk say, “No be this di one wey dem dey look for way to kill?
Look, e dey talk openly, and dem no talk anything to am. E fit be say di rulers know say na truly di Christ?
But we know where this man come from, but when di Christ come, nobody go know where e come from.”
So Jesus shout for di temple, dey teach and dey talk say, “Una know me, and una know where I come from. I no come by myself, but di one wey send me na true, wey una no know.
I know am, because I come from am, and e send me.”
So dem dey look for way to catch am; but nobody put hand on am, because im hour never reach.
But plenty from di crowd believe am. Dem talk say, “When di Christ come, e go do more signs pass wetin this man don do?”
Di Pharisees hear di crowd dey grumble these things about am, and di chief priests and di Pharisees send officers to arrest am.
Den Jesus talk say, “I go dey with una small time more, den I go go to di one wey send me.
Una go look for me, and una no go find me; and wia I dey, una no fit come.”
So di Jews talk among demself, “Wia this man go go wey we no go find am? E go go di Dispersion among di Greeks, teach di Greeks?
Wetin be this word wey e talk, ‘Una go look for me, and una no go find me; and wia I dey, una no fit come’?”
Now for di last and greatest day of di feast, Jesus stand shout, “If anybody thirsty, make e come to me and drink!
Di one wey believe me, as di Scripture talk, rivers of living water go flow from inside am.”
But e talk this about di Spirit, wey di people wey believe am go receive. Because Holy Spirit never dey given, because Jesus never receive im glory.
So plenty of di crowd, when dem hear these words, talk say, “Na truly di prophet.”
Others talk say, “Na di Christ.” But some talk say, “Wetin, di Christ dey come from Galilee?
Di Scripture no talk say di Christ dey come from David seed, and from Bethlehem, di village wia David dey?”
So division rise among di crowd because of am.
Some of dem want arrest am, but nobody put hands on am.
So di officers come to di chief priests and Pharisees, and dem talk to dem say, “Why una no bring am?”
Di officers answer, “No man ever talk like this man!”
So di Pharisees answer dem, “Dem don lead una astray too?
Any of di rulers believe am, or of di Pharisees?
But this crowd wey no know di law dey cursed.”
Nicodemus, di one wey come to am for night, as e be one of dem, talk to dem say,
“Our law dey judge man, unless e first hear from am personally and know wetin e do?”
Dem answer am, “You na Galilean too? Search, and see say no prophet don rise from Galilee.”
Everybody go im own house,
but Jesus go di Mount of Olives.
Now early for morning, e come again to di temple, and all di people come to am. E sit down, teach dem.
Di scribes and di Pharisees bring one woman wey dem catch dey commit adultery. As dem don put am for middle,
dem talk to am say, “Teacher, we find this woman dey commit adultery, for di very act.
Now for our law, Moses command us to stone such people. So wetin you talk about am?”
Dem talk this to test am, so that dem go get something to accuse am. But Jesus bend down, write for ground with im finger.
But as dem continue to ask am, e look up talk to dem say, “Di one among una wey no get sin, make e throw di first stone for am.”
Again e bend down, write for ground with im finger.
As dem hear am, dem conscience convict dem, dem go out one by one, from di oldest reach di last. Dem leave Jesus alone with di woman wia e dey, for middle.
Jesus get up, see nobody except di woman. E talk to am say, “Woman, wia your accusers dey? Nobody condemn you?”
E talk say, “Nobody, Lord.” Jesus talk say, “I no condemn you too. Go your way. From now, no sin again.”
So again Jesus talk to dem, dey talk say, “I be di light of di world. Di one wey follow me no go waka for darkness, but e go get di light of life.”
So di Pharisees talk to am say, “You dey testify about yourself. Your testimony no valid.”
Jesus answer dem, “Even if I testify about myself, my testimony na true, because I know wia I come from, and wia I dey go; but una no know wia I come from, or wia I dey go.
Una dey judge by flesh. I no dey judge anybody.
Even if I judge, my judgment na true, because I no dey alone, but I dey with Papa God wey send me.
E dey write for una law too say di testimony of two people valid.
I be one wey dey testify about myself, and Papa God wey send me dey testify about me.”
So dem talk to am say, “Wia your Papa dey?” Jesus answer, “Una no know me, and una no know my Papa God. If una know me, una go know my Papa God too.”
Jesus talk these words for di treasury, as e dey teach for di temple. Yet nobody arrest am, because im hour never reach.
So Jesus talk to dem again, “I dey go, and una go look for me, and una go die for una sins. Wia I dey go, una no fit come.”
So di Jews talk say, “E go kill imself, say e dey talk, ‘Wia I dey go, una no fit come’?”
E talk to dem say, “Una come from below. I come from above. Una belong to this world. I no belong to this world.
So I talk to una say una go die for una sins; because unless una believe say na me, una go die for una sins.”
So dem talk to am say, “Who you be?” Jesus talk to dem say, “Na just wetin I don dey talk to una from di beginning.
I get plenty things to talk and to judge about una. But di one wey send me na true; and di things wey I hear from am, na dem I dey talk to di world.”
Dem no understand say e dey talk to dem about Papa God.
So Jesus talk to dem say, “When una don lift up di Son of Man, den una go know say na me, and I no dey do anything by myself, but as my Papa God teach me, so I dey talk these things.
Di one wey send me dey with me. Papa God no leave me alone, because I always dey do di things wey please am.”
As e dey talk these things, plenty believe am.
So Jesus talk to those Jews wey believe am, “If una remain for my word, den una na my real disciples.
Una go know di truth, and di truth go free una.”
Dem answer am, “We be Abraham seed, and we never dey bondage to anybody. How you take talk, ‘Dem go free una’?”
Jesus answer dem, “Na true I dey tell una, everybody wey dey commit sin na bondservant of sin.
Bondservant no dey live for di house forever. Son dey remain forever.
So if di Pikin free una, una go free truly.
I know say una be Abraham seed, yet una dey look for way to kill me, because my word no get place inside una.
I dey talk di things wey I don see with my Papa God; and una dey do di things wey una don see with una papa.”
Dem answer am, “Our papa na Abraham.” Jesus talk to dem say, “If una be Abraham pikin dem, una go do di works of Abraham.
But now una dey look for way to kill me, man wey don tell una di truth, wey I hear from God. Abraham no do this.
Una dey do di works of una papa.” Dem talk to am say, “Dem no born us from sexual immorality. We get one Papa, God.”
So Jesus talk to dem say, “If God na una Papa, una go love me, because I come out and don come from God. Because I no come by myself, but e send me.
Why una no understand my speech? Because una no fit hear my word.

Una come from una papa, di devil, and una want do di desires of una papa. E be murderer from di beginning, and e no dey stand for di truth, because truth no dey inside am. When e talk lie, e dey talk from imself; because e be liar, and di papa of lies.
But because I dey tell di truth, una no believe me.
Which of una fit prove say I sin? If I dey tell di truth, why una no believe me?
Di one wey come from God dey hear God words. Na for this reason una no dey hear, because una no come from God.”
Den di Jews answer am, “We no talk well say you be Samaritan, and evil spirit dey inside you?”
Jesus answer, “Evil spirit no dey inside me, but I honor my Papa God, and una dey dishonor me.
But I no dey look for my own glory. One dey wey dey look for am and dey judge.
Na true I dey tell una, if person keep my word, e no go ever see death.”
Den di Jews talk to am say, “Now we know say evil spirit dey inside you. Abraham die, and di prophets; and you dey talk say, ‘If man keep my word, e no go ever taste death.’
You greater pass our papa Abraham, wey die? Di prophets die. Wetin you dey make yourself be?”
Jesus answer, “If I give myself glory, my glory no be anything. Na my Papa God dey give me glory, di one wey una dey talk say na our God.
Una no know am, but I know am. If I talk say, ‘I no know am,’ I go be like una, liar. But I know am, and I dey keep im word.
Una papa Abraham rejoice to see my day. E see am, and e glad.”
So di Jews talk to am say, “You never reach 50 years old, and you don see Abraham?”
Jesus talk to dem say, “Na true I dey tell una, before Abraham dey, I AM.”
So dem pick stones to throw am, but Jesus hide, and go out of di temple, pass through di middle of dem, and so e pass.
As e dey pass, e see man wey blind from birth.
Im disciples ask am, “Rabbi, who sin, this man or im parents, say e go born blind?”
Jesus answer, “No be this man sin, or im parents; but so that di works of God go reveal inside am.
I must do di works of di one wey send me while day dey. Night dey come, wey nobody fit work.
While I dey for di world, I be di light of di world.”
When e don talk this, e spit for ground, make mud with di saliva, put di mud for di blind man eyes,
and talk to am say, “Go, wash for di pool of Siloam,” wey mean Sent. So e go, wash, come back dey see.
So di neighbors, and di people wey see am before say e blind, talk say, “No be this di one wey dey sit dey beg?”
Others dey talk say, “Na am.” Others dey talk say, “E look like am.” E talk say, “Na me.”
So dem dey ask am, “How dem take open your eyes?”
E answer, “One man wey dem dey call Jesus make mud, put am for my eyes, talk to me say, ‘Go di pool of Siloam, wash.’ So I go wash, and I receive sight.”
Den dem ask am, “Wia e dey?” E talk say, “I no know.”
Dem bring di one wey blind before go meet di Pharisees.
Na Sabbath when Jesus make di mud and open im eyes.
So again di Pharisees ask am how e take receive im sight. E talk to dem say, “E put mud for my eyes, and I wash, and I dey see.”
So some of di Pharisees talk say, “This man no come from God, because e no dey keep Sabbath.” Others talk say, “How man wey be sinner fit do such signs?” Division dey among dem.
So dem ask di blind man again, “Wetin you talk about am, because e open your eyes?” E talk say, “E na prophet.”
So di Jews no believe about am say e don blind, and e receive im sight, until dem call di parents of di one wey receive im sight,
ask dem, “This na your son, wey una dey talk say dem born am blind? So how e take dey see now?”
Im parents answer dem, “We know say this na our son, and say dem born am blind;
but how e dey see now, we no know; or who open im eyes, we no know. E don grow. Ask am. E go talk for imself.”
Im parents talk these things because dem fear di Jews; because di Jews don agree already say if any man confess am as Christ, dem go put am out of di synagogue.
So im parents talk say, “E don grow. Ask am.”
So dem call di man wey blind second time, talk to am say, “Give God glory. We know say this man na sinner.”
So e answer, “I no know if e be sinner. One thing I know: say though I blind, now I dey see.”
Dem talk to am again, “Wetin e do to you? How e open your eyes?”
E answer dem, “I don tell una already, and una no listen. Why una want hear am again? Una no want become im disciples too?”
Dem insult am, talk say, “You be im disciple, but we be Moses disciples.
We know say God don talk to Moses. But as for this man, we no know where e come from.”
Di man answer dem, “E amazing! Una no know where e come from, yet e open my eyes.
We know say God no dey listen to sinners, but if anybody na God worshiper, and dey do im will, e dey listen to am.
Since di world begin, nobody ever hear say anybody open di eyes of person wey dem born blind.
If this man no come from God, e no go fit do anything.”
Dem answer am, “Dem born you for sins completely, and you dey teach us?” Dem throw am out.
Jesus hear say dem don throw am out, and as e find am, e talk say, “You believe for God Pikin?”
E answer, “Who e be, Lord, so that I go believe am?”
Jesus talk to am say, “You don see am, and na im dey talk with you.”
E talk say, “Lord, I believe!” and e worship am.
Jesus talk say, “I come enter this world for judgment, so that di people wey no see go see; and di people wey see go become blind.”
Di Pharisees wey dey with am hear these things, talk to am say, “We blind too?”
Jesus talk to dem say, “If una blind, una no go get sin; but now una dey talk say, ‘We see.’ So una sin remain.”
